verses.greek: Ἐγένοντο δὲ καὶ ψευδοπροφῆται ἐν τῷ λαῷ, ὡς καὶ ἐν ὑμῖν ἔσονται ψευδοδιδάσκαλοι, οἵτινες παρεισάξουσιν αἱρέσεις ἀπωλείας, καὶ τὸν ἀγοράσαντα αὐτοὺς δεσπότην ἀρνούμενοι, ἐπάγοντες ἑαυτοῖς ταχινὴν ἀπώλειαν·
verses.literal: There were however also false prophets among the people as also among you there will be false teachers who will stealthily introduce heresies destructive even the having bought them Master denying bringing upon themselves imminent destruction
verses.dgt: But false prophets also arose among the people, just as there will also be false teachers among you, who will secretly bring in destructive heresies, even denying the Master who bought them, bringing swift destruction on themselves.

verses.greek: καὶ πολλοὶ ἐξακολουθήσουσιν αὐτῶν ταῖς ἀσελγείαις, διʼ οὓς ἡ ὁδὸς τῆς ἀληθείας βλασφημηθήσεται·
verses.literal: And many will follow after their the sensuality through whom the way of the truth will be denigrated
verses.dgt: And many will follow their sensual ways, because of whom the way of truth will be blasphemed.

verses.greek: καὶ ἐν πλεονεξίᾳ πλαστοῖς λόγοις ὑμᾶς ἐμπορεύσονται· οἷς τὸ κρίμα ἔκπαλαι οὐκ ἀργεῖ, καὶ ἡ ἀπώλεια αὐτῶν οὐ νυστάζει.
verses.literal: And through covetousness with fabricated words you they will exploit for whom the judgment of long ago not is idle and the destruction of them not slumbers.
verses.dgt: And in greed they will exploit you with fabricated words. Their judgment from long ago is not idle, and their destruction does not slumber.

verses.greek: Εἰ γὰρ ὁ θεὸς ἀγγέλων ἁμαρτησάντων οὐκ ἐφείσατο, ἀλλὰ σειραῖς ζόφου ταρταρώσας παρέδωκεν εἰς κρίσιν τηρουμένους,
verses.literal: If for the God of the angels who having sinned not spared but in chains of gloomy darkness to Tartarus He delivered them for judgment being kept
verses.dgt: For if God did not spare angels when they sinned, but cast them into Tartarus and delivered them to chains of gloomy darkness, kept for judgment,

verses.greek: καὶ ἀρχαίου κόσμου οὐκ ἐφείσατο, ἀλλὰ ὄγδοον Νῶε δικαιοσύνης κήρυκα ἐφύλαξεν, κατακλυσμὸν κόσμῳ ἀσεβῶν ἐπάξας,
verses.literal: and the ancient world not He spared but one of eight Noah of righteousness a herald preserved the flood upon the world of the ungodly having brought in
verses.dgt: and did not spare the ancient world, but preserved Noah, an eighth person, a herald of righteousness, when he brought a flood on a world of ungodly people,

verses.greek: καὶ πόλεις Σοδόμων καὶ Γομόρρας τεφρώσας καταστροφῇ κατέκρινεν, ὑπόδειγμα μελλόντων ἀσεβέσιν τεθεικώς,
verses.literal: and the cities of Sodom and Gomorrah having reduced to ashes to destruction He condemned them an example of what is coming on ungodly having set
verses.dgt: and by reducing the cities of Sodom and Gomorrah to ashes condemned them to destruction, making them an example of what is going to happen to the ungodly,

verses.greek: καὶ δίκαιον Λὼτ καταπονούμενον ὑπὸ τῆς τῶν ἀθέσμων ἐν ἀσελγείᾳ ἀναστροφῆς ἐρρύσατο—
verses.literal: and righteous Lot being distressed by the of the lawless in sensuality conduct He rescued
verses.dgt: and rescued righteous Lot, distressed by the sensual conduct of lawless people—

verses.greek: βλέμματι γὰρ καὶ ἀκοῇ ὁ δίκαιος ἐγκατοικῶν ἐν αὐτοῖς ἡμέραν ἐξ ἡμέρας ψυχὴν δικαίαν ἀνόμοις ἔργοις ἐβασάνιζεν—
verses.literal: through seeing for and hearing that righteous man dwelling among them day after day in his soul righteous with their lawless deeds was tormented
verses.dgt: for that righteous man, living among them day after day, tormented his righteous soul by what he saw and heard of their lawless deeds—

verses.greek: οἶδεν κύριος εὐσεβεῖς ἐκ πειρασμοῦ ῥύεσθαι, ἀδίκους δὲ εἰς ἡμέραν κρίσεως κολαζομένους τηρεῖν,
verses.literal: then knows the Lord the devout out of temptation to deliver the unrighteous then unto the day of judgment being punished to keep
verses.dgt: then the Lord knows how to rescue the godly from trial and to keep the unrighteous under punishment for the day of judgment,

verses.greek: μάλιστα δὲ τοὺς ὀπίσω σαρκὸς ἐν ἐπιθυμίᾳ μιασμοῦ πορευομένους καὶ κυριότητος καταφρονοῦντας. Τολμηταί, αὐθάδεις, δόξας οὐ τρέμουσιν, βλασφημοῦντες,
verses.literal: especially then those after the flesh in the passion of defilement walking and authority despising. Bold self-willed glorious ones not they tremble blaspheming
verses.dgt: and especially those who go after the flesh in defiling desire and despise authority. Bold and self-willed, they do not tremble when blaspheming glorious beings,

verses.greek: ὅπου ἄγγελοι ἰσχύϊ καὶ δυνάμει μείζονες ὄντες οὐ φέρουσιν κατʼ αὐτῶν βλάσφημον κρίσιν.
verses.literal: whereas angels in strength and in power greater being not they do bring against them a reviling judgment.
verses.dgt: whereas angels, though greater in strength and power, do not bring a blasphemous judgment against them before the Lord.

verses.greek: οὗτοι δέ, ὡς ἄλογα ζῷα γεγεννημένα φυσικὰ εἰς ἅλωσιν καὶ φθοράν, ἐν οἷς ἀγνοοῦσιν βλασφημοῦντες, ἐν τῇ φθορᾷ αὐτῶν καὶ φθαρήσονται,
verses.literal: These however like irrational animals they were born as creatures of instinct for capture and destruction in what they are ignorant of blaspheming in the destruction of them also will be destroyed
verses.dgt: But these people, like irrational animals born by nature for capture and destruction, blaspheming in matters of which they are ignorant, will also be destroyed in their destruction,

verses.greek: ἀδικούμενοι μισθὸν ἀδικίας· ἡδονὴν ἡγούμενοι τὴν ἐν ἡμέρᾳ τρυφήν, σπίλοι καὶ μῶμοι ἐντρυφῶντες ἐν ταῖς ἀπάταις αὐτῶν συνευωχούμενοι ὑμῖν,
verses.literal: suffering as the wage of unrighteousness. as pleasure esteeming the in daytime carousal blots and blemishes reveling in the deceptions of them feasting with you
verses.dgt: suffering wrong as the wages of wrongdoing. They consider indulgence in the daytime a pleasure. They are spots and blemishes, reveling in their deceptions while feasting with you,

verses.greek: ὀφθαλμοὺς ἔχοντες μεστοὺς μοιχαλίδος καὶ ἀκαταπαύστους ἁμαρτίας, δελεάζοντες ψυχὰς ἀστηρίκτους, καρδίαν γεγυμνασμένην πλεονεξίας ἔχοντες, κατάρας τέκνα,
verses.literal: eyes having full of adultery and unceasing from sin enticing souls unestablished a heart exercised in craving having — of a curse children!
verses.dgt: having eyes full of adultery and unable to stop sinning, enticing unstable souls, having hearts trained in greed—children of a curse.

verses.greek: καταλιπόντες εὐθεῖαν ὁδὸν ἐπλανήθησαν, ἐξακολουθήσαντες τῇ ὁδῷ τοῦ Βαλαὰμ τοῦ Βοσὸρ ὃς μισθὸν ἀδικίας ἠγάπησεν
verses.literal: leaving straight way they have gone astray having followed in the way the of Balaam the son of Bosor who the wage of unrighteousness loved
verses.dgt: Abandoning the straight way, they went astray, following the way of Balaam son of Bosor, who loved the wages of wrongdoing,

verses.greek: ἔλεγξιν δὲ ἔσχεν ἰδίας παρανομίας· ὑποζύγιον ἄφωνον ἐν ἀνθρώπου φωνῇ φθεγξάμενον ἐκώλυσεν τὴν τοῦ προφήτου παραφρονίαν.
verses.literal: reproof however he had for his own transgression by a donkey mute in a man’s voice having spoken it restrained the of the prophet madness.
verses.dgt: but received a rebuke for his own lawlessness: a speechless beast of burden, speaking with a human voice, restrained the prophet’s madness.

verses.greek: Οὗτοί εἰσιν πηγαὶ ἄνυδροι καὶ ὁμίχλαι ὑπὸ λαίλαπος ἐλαυνόμεναι, οἷς ὁ ζόφος τοῦ σκότους τετήρηται.
verses.literal: These are springs without water and mists by storm being driven for whom the gloom the of darkness has been reserved.
verses.dgt: These are waterless springs and mists driven by a storm, for whom the gloom of darkness has been kept.

verses.greek: ὑπέρογκα γὰρ ματαιότητος φθεγγόμενοι δελεάζουσιν ἐν ἐπιθυμίαις σαρκὸς ἀσελγείαις τοὺς ὀλίγως ἀποφεύγοντας τοὺς ἐν πλάνῃ ἀναστρεφομένους,
verses.literal: Arrogant for of vanity speaking words they entice with the passions of the flesh to sensuality those scarcely escaping from those in error living
verses.dgt: For speaking arrogant words of emptiness, they entice by fleshly desires and sensuality those who are barely escaping from people who live in error.

verses.greek: ἐλευθερίαν αὐτοῖς ἐπαγγελλόμενοι, αὐτοὶ δοῦλοι ὑπάρχοντες τῆς φθορᾶς· ᾧ γάρ τις ἥττηται, τούτῳ καὶ δεδούλωται.
verses.literal: freedom them promising themselves slaves being the of corruption By what for anyone has been subdued by that and he has been enslaved.
verses.dgt: They promise them freedom, while they themselves are slaves of corruption. For whatever someone is overcome by, to this that person is enslaved.

verses.greek: εἰ γὰρ ἀποφυγόντες τὰ μιάσματα τοῦ κόσμου ἐν ἐπιγνώσει τοῦ κυρίου καὶ σωτῆρος Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ τούτοις δὲ πάλιν ἐμπλακέντες ἡττῶνται, γέγονεν αὐτοῖς τὰ ἔσχατα χείρονα τῶν πρώτων.
verses.literal: If for having escaped the pollutions of the world through the knowledge of the Lord and Savior Jesus Christ in these now again having been entangled they are subdued has become to them the last state worse than the first.
verses.dgt: For if, after escaping the defilements of the world through the knowledge of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ, they are again entangled in these things and overcome, the last state has become worse for them than the first.

verses.greek: κρεῖττον γὰρ ἦν αὐτοῖς μὴ ἐπεγνωκέναι τὴν ὁδὸν τῆς δικαιοσύνης ἢ ἐπιγνοῦσιν ὑποστρέψαι ἐκ τῆς παραδοθείσης αὐτοῖς ἁγίας ἐντολῆς·
verses.literal: Better for it was being for them not to have known the way the of righteousness than having known it to have turned from the having been delivered to them holy commandment.
verses.dgt: For it would have been better for them not to have known the way of righteousness than, after knowing it, to turn back from the holy commandment delivered to them.

verses.greek: συμβέβηκεν αὐτοῖς τὸ τῆς ἀληθοῦς παροιμίας· Κύων ἐπιστρέψας ἐπὶ τὸ ἴδιον ἐξέραμα, καί· Ὗς λουσαμένη εἰς κυλισμὸν βορβόρου.
verses.literal: Has happened to them the thing of the true proverb: A dog having returned to the its own vomit and A sow having washed to her rolling place in the mire.
verses.dgt: What the true proverb says has happened to them: “A dog returns to its own vomit,” and, “A washed sow returns to rolling in mud.”
